derivations.name: M1 = 0 and M2 = 1.000 are identities of the Path-1 code
derivations.statement: For any inputs Path 1 can construct, the Frobenius permutation of the 2^{m-2} fibre x-values is translation by g in (Z/2)^{m-2}, g_i = chi_i * chi_1; hence the cycle type is 1^{2^{m-2}} (g trivial) or 2^{2^{m-3}} (g non-trivial), and the observed permutation equals predicted_permutation identically.
steps: fields.Fp2.sqrt_of_fp_element returns (a,0) if chi=+1 else (0,s); conj((a,b))=(a,-b); therefore conj(Y_i) = chi_i * Y_i exactly.
X_i = from_fp(x_i) lies in F_p, so conj(X_i) = X_i; hence conj(P_i) = (X_i, chi_i Y_i) = [chi_i] P_i since -(X,Y)=(X,-Y).
ec_add_fp2 is an F_p-rational map in the coordinates and A_fp2 = from_fp(A) is F_p-rational; conj is an F_p-automorphism of F_{p^2}; therefore conj commutes with the addition.
conj(Q_eps) = chi_1 P_1 + eps_2 chi_2 P_2 + ... = [chi_1](Q_{eps*g}); taking x-coordinates, conj(x(Q_eps)) = x(Q_{eps*g}).
derivations.corollary: measured_null_1 cannot emit a forbidden cycle type for ANY companion object; the hypothesis's nearby_object_control premise is false.
